title: Finland built a lighthouse in Sweden, so they bent the border
description:
On Märket, a bare Baltic rock shared by Sweden and Finland, the border zigzags around a Finnish lighthouse that was built on the Swedish side in 1885.

Sources:
- Lagutskottets betänkande 1984/85:16 om ändring av riksgränsen mellan Sverige och Finland (committee report on changing the Sweden-Finland border, 29 January 1985) — Sveriges riksdag (Swedish Parliament): https://data.riksdagen.se/dokument/G801LU16.html
- Märket — Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%A4rket
